OpenAI announces the launch of a new programme called the "ChatGPT for Small Business Programme", while also claiming that ChatGPT Work and Codex users have surpassed 10 million.

ChatGPT for Small Business Programme

OpenAI said the newly launched ChatGPT for Small Business Programme is "an initiative designed to help small businesses boost productivity and scale their operations with the help of ChatGPT".

The programme includes four key components: participation in virtual hands-on training, attendance at offline Small Business AI Academy events held in the United States, a practical beginner's guide to ChatGPT, and brand-new agent tools and partner resources tailored specifically for small businesses.

OpenAI has set up a sign-up form, allowing small businesses to register and join the programme.

For more information about the OpenAI Small Business Programme, please click here.

ChatGPT Work and Codex users surpass 10 million

This move is part of OpenAI's overall push for ChatGPT Work. ChatGPT Work is a more agentic version of ChatGPT, capable of executing a wider range of productivity tasks beyond the response capabilities of ordinary chatbots.

The number of users of OpenAI's ChatGPT Work and Codex has surpassed the 10 million mark, doubling the number of standalone Codex users from early July.

Earlier this month, OpenAI replaced its desktop application with a new version developed based on the standalone Codex application, adding more advanced features while also making the basic chat interface more complex. The application has since been updated multiple times to strike a better balance between chat and task handling.
